title: Camellia
description: A mod that adds various types of tea with immersive brewing mechanic
body:
### About
**Camellia** is an immersive mod that adds various types of tea.

First of all, you need to obtain a tea leaf. Sniffer can now help you find it.

You can process your tea leaves and change their parameters by **Shift + Right-Clicking** on specific blocks:
| Block              | Parameter Granted |
|--------------------|-------------------|
| Crafting Table     | Rolled            |
| Campfire           | Withered          |
| Scaffolding        | Dried             |

To brew a cup, you must process the tea leaves in a specific sequence unique to each tea variety:
| Tea               | Ingredients       | Steps                              |
|-------------------|-------------------|------------------------------------|
| White Tea         | Tea leaf          | Withered > Dried                   |
| Green Tea         | Tea leaf          | Dried                              |
| Oolong Tea        | Tea leaf          | Dried > Rolled > Withered          |
| Black Tea         | Tea leaf          | Dried > Withered                   |
| Lavender Tea      | Lavender          | -                                  |
| Hibiscus Tea      | Hibiscus          | -                                  |
| Shu Puer Tea      | Tea leaf          | Withered > Rolled > Dried > Rolled |

After processing your ingredients, place a teapot on block that emits heat (such as a furnace, campfire, or even magma), fill it with water, and add your processed tea leaves to it. Wait until white steam begins to rise from the pot, and your brewed tea will be ready!

Mod compatible with [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) and [Nature's Spirit](https://modrinth.com/mod/natures-spirit)
